description: The file is a PHP unit test class named FileTest, testing various functionalities of a File handling system, including file upload, existence checks, content operations, and deletion within different file storage contexts (local or S3).

classes.name: FileTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing file operations such as upload, existence, content manipulation, and deletion, on different storage backends (local or S3).

methods.name: setUpBeforeClass
methods.description: Initializes test environment, sets handler type based on configuration, prepares a test image file with base64 content, and records start time.

methods.name: testFactory
methods.description: Verifies that the file handler factory produces the correct class instance (S3File or LocalFile).

methods.name: testDontExistFirst
methods.description: Checks that a specific test image file does not exist initially.

methods.name: testUpload
methods.description: Uploads a test image file and verifies upload success; also tests failure scenario.

methods.name: testPutGetContents
methods.description: Tests writing to and reading from a file, verifying content integrity.

methods.name: testExists
methods.description: Checks the existence of uploaded files and non-existence of a non-uploaded file.

methods.name: testGetSaveName
methods.description: Verifies the filename conversion to a save name.

methods.name: testFileModificationTime
methods.description: Checks that file modification times are recent relative to test start time.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Deletes files and verifies auto-deletion behavior and cleanup of test directories.

methods.name: tearDownAfterClass
methods.description: Cleans up the temporary test image file after all tests are completed.
